newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin may visit Kremlin next week - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin may visit Kremlin next week - doctor.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin could return to the Kremlin for brief visits as early as next week, Interfax news agency on Thursday quoted the president's chief doctor Sergei Mironov as saying.
Yeltsin, 65, is recovering from open heart surgery at the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow.
"It is possible that after December 5 the president will make a few test visits to the Kremlin from Barvikha," Interfax quoted Mironov as saying.

Mironov said Yeltsin's recovery was progressing smoothly and the president would probably stay at Barvikha for two or three "We hope that after December 15-20 Boris Nikolayevich (Yeltsin) will be able to work at the Kremlin practically at his normal rhythm," Interfax quoted him as saying.
Yeltsin, dogged by ill health, has spent very little time in the Kremlin since his re-election last July. He underwent quintuple heart bypass surgery on November 5.
